Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — breadth over depth: SQL, networking, OOP and REST alongside LeetCode-style coding in the same loop
rounds: Onsite/Superday: 3 back-to-back 1-hour technical rounds (coding on a whiteboard/shared doc) plus a behavioral round
extraTopics: Breadth: SQL, basic networking, OOP, REST APIs, sometimes Linux, alongside DSA in the same round
Defending every technology named on your resume in detail (Kafka, Kubernetes, OAuth, etc.)

Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — same breadth-first format with a deeper resume interrogation and open-ended design prompts
rounds: Similar loop with a heavier system design component (e.g. an open-ended elevator-system design prompt) and deeper resume follow-ups
extraTopics: Reasoning through trade-offs on open-ended design prompts, not just reaching an optimal answer
